description: Industrial UV radiation sensor, 240 to 395 nm, RS-485 (Modbus RTU)
source: Seeed Technology, "UV Radiation Sensor (S-ZW-01) User Manual", V1.0

sources.title: Industrial UV Radiation Sensor MODBUS-RTU RS485 (SKU 101991048)

notes: The reading is taken with FC03 from register 0; the manual's example answers 0x0050 = 80 W/m².
Factory settings: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit. The manual gives 47 (decimal) as the default address of this sensor; its examples use address 1.

To change the address, write the new address to register 0x0100 with FC06 (the broadcast address 0xFE reaches a single sensor whose address is unknown). A changed address or communication setting takes effect after the sensor is powered off and on.
Range 0 to 200 W/m², resolution 1 W/m², supply 5 to 24 V DC.

registers.name: Device address
registers.description: Takes effect after the sensor is powered off and on
